description: Quotes an exact-input swap on Uniswap v3 on Monad. Returns amount out, best fee tier, and gas estimate. Read-only — calls QuoterV2 via eth_call.

amount_in.description: Amount of tokenIn to sell, e.g. "10".

fee.description: Uniswap v3 fee tier in bps*100. If omitted, the tool tries each tier and returns the best quote.

network.description: Monad network — "mainnet" or "testnet". Defaults to the server's configured network.

token_in.description: Address of the token being sold.

token_out.description: Address of the token being bought.

name: uniswap_quote
title: Get a Uniswap v3 swap quote
